infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Atur only touches your photo library when you choose to attach an image or save a screenshot of a bug report.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Atur saves an image to your photo library only when you ask it to.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Atur uses the microphone only while you dictate text, for example a comment or a prompt to an agent.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Atur turns your speech into text on your iPhone when you tap the microphone button.
infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Atur connects straight to your computer on your network or Tailscale.

plugins.faceIDPermission: Atur can use Face ID to protect your saved sign-in.

plugins.cameraPermission: Atur uses the camera only to scan the pairing code shown by Atur Terminal on your computer.

plugins.microphonePermission: Atur uses the microphone only while you dictate into a text field. Audio is turned into text on your device and is never recorded or sent to Atur.
plugins.speechRecognitionPermission: Atur uses speech recognition to turn what you say into text in comments, issues and feedback. It runs on your device when your phone supports it.

plugins.photosPermission: Atur opens your photo library only when you choose an image to attach to a comment.
plugins.cameraPermission: Atur uses the camera only when you take a photo to attach to a comment, or to scan the pairing code shown by Atur Terminal on your computer.
plugins.microphonePermission: Atur uses the microphone only while you dictate into a text field. Audio is turned into text on your device and is never recorded or sent to Atur.
